info.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash Image-to-Video
info.description: Generate a video with native audio from one first-frame image or a first-and-last-frame pair

post.description:
- Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash (`gemini-omni-1.2-flash-image-to-video`) generates video with native audio from images and a text prompt.
- **First and last frames:** `image_urls` accepts 1–2 images. One image supplies the first frame. With two images, the first is the starting frame and the second is the ending frame; the model generates the transition. A last frame cannot be supplied alone.
- **Resolution:** `quality` accepts `360p`, `720p`, `1080p`, or `4k`; default `720p`.
- **Duration:** Integer seconds via `duration`, default `3`. One first frame supports `3–15` seconds; a first-and-last-frame pair supports `3–10` seconds.
- **Aspect ratio:** `16:9`, `9:16`, or `auto`; default `auto`.
- Synchronized native audio is generated automatically, with no additional parameter.
- Write negative requirements directly in `prompt` (for example, `No dialogue`); there is no separate negative prompt parameter.
- Set `seed` to improve reproducibility.
- Asynchronous processing: use the returned task ID to [query task status](/en/api-manual/task-management/get-task-detail).
- Generated video links remain valid for 24 hours; save them promptly.

prompt.description:
Text prompt describing how the first frame should move and how the scene should evolve.

Supports Chinese and English. For more stable results, describe the desired action and changes clearly. Write negative requirements directly in `prompt`, such as `No dialogue` or `No text`; there is no separate negative prompt parameter.

The prompt is required and must not be empty or contain only whitespace.
prompt.example: The person slowly turns their head and smiles while leaves in the background sway gently in the wind.

image_urls.description:
First/last-frame image array, containing 1–2 images.

- One image: the **first frame**.
- Two images: the **first frame**, then the **last frame**. The model generates a transition between them; maximum `duration` is `10` seconds.
- A last frame must accompany a first frame and cannot be supplied alone.

Only HTTP/HTTPS image URLs are supported. Formats: `png`, `jpeg`, `webp`.

quality.description:
Video resolution; default `720p`.

**Supported values:**
- `360p`: landscape 640×360 / portrait 360×640
- `720p`: landscape 1280×720 / portrait 720×1280; default
- `1080p`: landscape 1920×1080 / portrait 1080×1920
- `4k`: landscape 3840×2160 / portrait 2160×3840

Orientation is controlled by `aspect_ratio`: `16:9` produces landscape and `9:16` produces portrait.

**Billing:** Video output is billed by output tokens, which scale linearly with resolution. Relative to `720p`, `360p` uses about one third, `1080p` about 1.5×, and `4k` about 3×. Actual charges are based on generated usage.

duration.description:
Video duration in seconds; default `3`.

- One first-frame image: any integer from `3` to `15`.
- Two first/last-frame images: any integer from `3` to `10`.
- Duration directly affects billing.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio: 16:9, 9:16, or auto; default auto.

seed.description:
Random seed; random by default.

- Range: `0`–`4294967295`.
- Fixing the seed reduces variation from parameter changes when tuning prompts and improves reproducibility.

callback_url.description:
HTTPS callback URL to notify when the task completes

**Callback timing:**
- Triggered when the task completes (completed), fails (failed), or is cancelled (cancelled)
- Sent after billing is confirmed

**Security restrictions:**
- HTTPS protocol only
- Callbacks to internal IP addresses are forbidden (127.0.0.1, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, etc.)
- URL length must not exceed `2048` characters

**Callback mechanism:**
- Timeout: `10` seconds
- Up to `3` retries on failure (retried `1`s / `2`s / `4`s after each failure respectively)
- The callback body format matches the response of the task query endpoint
- A 2xx status code from the callback URL is treated as success; other status codes trigger a retry
